note: These links point at Anthropic's own catalogue and documentation — this app cannot enrol you and does not need your Academy account. This is the free preparation path Anthropic lists on the CCAF certification page, in the order shown there.

exam_logistics.scheduling_note: Scheduling and delivery for this and other Anthropic certifications runs through Pearson VUE. This app does not schedule exams — use the certification page above, which hands off to Pearson VUE once you register.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
courses.why: Establishes the Delegation / Description / Discernment / Diligence vocabulary that underpins effective, safe collaboration with Claude — the frame every other course builds on.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.why: Everyday use of Claude, the core features, and where to go for more — the on-ramp before the API and Claude Code material gets specific.

courses.title: Building with the Claude API
courses.why: Authentication, prompt engineering, evaluations, tool use and agents through the Messages API — the substrate every SDK and structured-output question sits on.

courses.title: Claude with Amazon Bedrock
courses.why: Setup and production patterns for running Claude through Bedrock — the enterprise-deployment path that shows up directly in configuration and workflow questions.

courses.title: Claude on Google Cloud
courses.why: The Vertex AI counterpart to the Bedrock course — same setup-through-production arc, different cloud, same exam-relevant deployment reasoning.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.why: Building MCP servers and clients from scratch in Python — tools, resources and prompts, connecting Claude to external services. The single highest-yield course for the Tool Design & MCP domain.

courses.title: Claude Code in Action
courses.why: Claude Code integrated into real development workflows: context management, custom commands, hooks and the Agent SDK. The broadest single course on the list — it touches three of the five domains.

courses.title: Prompt Engineering Interactive Tutorial
courses.why: Not on Anthropic's official prep list, but the deepest hands-on treatment of role prompting, structuring and few-shot technique — directly assessed in Prompt Engineering & Structured Output.

courses.title: Claude Agent SDK reference
courses.why: Supplements 'Claude Code in Action' with the full query()/ClaudeSDKClient API surface, permission callbacks and custom tool registration used throughout the Agentic Architecture domain.

courses.title: Claude Code security & permissions reference
courses.why: The exam has no standalone 'security' domain — permission rules live in Configuration & Workflows and injection/containment reasoning lives in Context Management & Reliability. This is the reference for both.

study_plan.target: Three timed exam-mode sittings, 80%+ with zero domain under 65%
